title: Family with Babies in Backyard Garden, 1942 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white outdoor snapshot taken in May 1942 showing a family in a shady backyard garden. The father, wearing a straw fedora hat, light shirt, and high-waisted trousers, holds a small toddler on his hip. Beside him, the mother wears a patterned dress and spectacles, proudly smiling as she holds a newborn baby wrapped in light clothes—annotated on the back as Carolyn's first public appearance. Taken during World War II era America, the scene highlights domestic life and family warmth.
